texts.preamble: Mohammad Sohail S/O Mohammad Shakir vs State Of Maharashtra Thr Pso., Ps ... on 12 March, 2026 2026:Bhc-Nag:4276 1 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay, Nagpur Bench, Nagpur. Criminal Application (Aba) No. 35 Of 2026 Mohd. Sohail S/o. Mohd. Shakir Vs. State of Maharashtra -------------------------------------------------------------------- Office Notes, Office Memoranda of Court' Coram, appearances, Court's Orders or directions and Registrar's order -------------------------------------------------------------------- Shri K. R. Bhise, Advocate for applicant. Shri C. A. Lokhande, App for non-applicant/State. Coram :- M. W. Chandwani, J. Dated :- 12.03.2026 The applicant seeks anticipatory bail in connection with Crime No. 531/2025 registered with Police Station Ganeshpeth, Nagpur for the offences punishable under Sections 123, 223, 274 and 275 of the Bhartiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 with Sections 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(e), 30(2)(a), 3(1)(zz)(iv) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
texts.facts: 3. The case-diary reveals that on 26.10.2025, after receipt of information, the Police conducted a raid at office of the Hans Travels at Nagpur and found one parcel containing contraband scented gutka. Later on, it was revealed that the said contraband was booked from RR Jaiswal 2 54-aba-35--26.odt Raipur office of Hans Travels to be transported to Pune. The said contraband was seized by the Police in the raid. 4. It appears that some of the persons from the office of Hans Travels were arrested. The applicant is working as Manger in the office of Hans Travel at Raipur. The entire contraband has already been seized by the Police and it is also informed that the charge-sheet has been filed. Hence, it appears that nothing is required to be seized from the applicant. The applicant was protected by ad-interim order of this Court with a direction to attend the concerned Police Station. Under the dictum of this Court, the applicant attended the concerned Police Station and co-operated in the investigation.
